DA_ME_start_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_ME_can_build_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = yes }
		owner = {
			DA_enchanted_building_material_spend = { amount = 20 }
			DA_arcane_metal_spend = { amount = 15 }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
		add_building_construction = { building = DA_ME_work_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 cost = 1 speed = 1 }
		# Safety net: if the engine refused the construction, give the materials back.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_construction = any } }
			DA_ME_refund_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = yes
		}
		owner = { DA_ME_recount = yes }
	}
}
DA_ME_refund_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	owner = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 15 }
	}
}
DA_ME_cancel_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
		DA_ME_refund_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = yes
	}
	owner = { DA_ME_recount = yes }
}
DA_ME_complete_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1 = {
	remove_building = DA_ME_work_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1
	clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_Mega_Engineering_mod.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve duration = -1 }
	set_province_flag = DA_ME_just_completed.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve_1
	province_event = { id = DA_Mega_Engineering_events.2 }
	owner = {
		set_country_flag = DA_ME_tracks_structures

	}
}

		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 30 }
	}
}
DA_ME_cancel_Mega_Port_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port }
		DA_ME_refund_Mega_Port_1 = yes
	}
	owner = { DA_ME_recount = yes }
}
DA_ME_complete_Mega_Port_1 = {
	remove_building = DA_ME_work_Mega_Port_1
	clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_Mega_Engineering_mod.Mega_Port duration = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1 } }
		add_center_of_trade_level = 1
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_ME_just_completed.Mega_Port_1
	province_event = { id = DA_Mega_Engineering_events.2 }
	owner = {
		set_country_flag = DA_ME_tracks_structures
		DA_ME_recount = yes
	}
}

# A work site that no longer exists (for example after conquest) must not block the province.
DA_ME_clear_stale_construction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.ambient_mana_collector
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.ambient_mana_collector
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Anti_Magic_Barrier
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Anti_Magic_Barrier
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Floating_Fortress
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Floating_Fortress
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Core_Driller
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Core_Driller
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Hold
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Hold
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Megalopolis
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Megalopolis
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port
			NOT = { has_construction = any }
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port
	}
}

# on_province_owner_change, ROOT = province, FROM = previous owner
DA_ME_on_owner_change = {
	owner = {
		set_country_flag = DA_ME_tracks_structures
		DA_ME_recount = yes
	}
	FROM = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_ME_tracks_structures }
			DA_ME_recount = yes
		}
	}
}

######## Country scope ########

# Counts completed structures (DA_ME_built_*) and completed + under construction (DA_ME_count_*),
# refreshes the country modifiers and the research percentage shown in the interface.
DA_ME_recount = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_ambient_mana_collector value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Anti_Magic_Barrier value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Anti_Magic_Barrier value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Floating_Fortress value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Floating_Fortress value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Core_Driller value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Core_Driller value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Hold value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Hold value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Megalopolis value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Megalopolis value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Port value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { DA_ME_province_has_any = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_ambient_mana_collector = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_ambient_mana_collector value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.ambient_mana_collector }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_ambient_mana_collector value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Anti_Magic_Barrier = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Anti_Magic_Barrier value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Anti_Magic_Barrier value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Anti_Magic_Barrier }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Anti_Magic_Barrier value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Floating_Fortress = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Floating_Fortress value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Floating_Fortress value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Floating_Fortress }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Floating_Fortress value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Core_Driller = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Core_Driller value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Core_Driller value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Core_Driller }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Core_Driller value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Mega_Hold = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Hold value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Hold value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Hold }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Hold value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Megalopolis = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Megalopolis value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Megalopolis value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Megalopolis }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Megalopolis value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_ME_has_Mega_Port = yes }
			owner = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Port value = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ME_building.Mega_Port }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ME_count_Mega_Port value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	DA_ME_refresh_country_modifiers = yes
	DA_ME_refresh_research_display = yes
}

DA_ME_refresh_country_modifiers = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve which = DA_ME_applied_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 3 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.3 duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 2 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.2 duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve value = 1 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve.1 duration = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve which = DA_ME_built_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector which = DA_ME_applied_ambient_mana_collector }
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_ambient_mana_collector which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.3
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector value = 3 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.3 duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector value = 2 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.2 duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector value = 1 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.ambient_mana_collector.1 duration = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_ambient_mana_collector which = DA_ME_built_ambient_mana_collector }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port which = DA_ME_applied_Mega_Port }
					check_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_Mega_Port which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.Mega_Port.1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_ME_country.Mega_Port.2
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port value = 2 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.Mega_Port.2 duration = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port value = 1 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ME_country.Mega_Port.1 duration = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_ME_applied_Mega_Port which = DA_ME_built_Mega_Port }
	}
}

DA_ME_refresh_research_display = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_ME_research_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress
			check_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_MAX value = 0.001 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_ME_research_pct which = DA_research_progress }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_ME_research_pct which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_ME_research_pct value = 100 }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ME_research_pct value = 0 }
	}
}

DA_ME_monthly = {
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { DA_ME_province_is_building = yes }
		DA_ME_clear_stale_construction = yes
	}
	DA_ME_recount = yes
}

# Called by the Mega Engineering option of DA_project_event.360.
DA_ME_unlock_path = {
	set_country_flag = DA_unlocked.mega_engineering
	set_country_flag = DA_ME_tracks_structures
	DA_ME_recount = yes
}

# Research dispatcher hooks (called from DA_research_gives_reward and DA_reset_research).
DA_ME_research_rewards = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve }
		DA_Complete.ME_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_ambient_mana_collector }
		DA_Complete.ME_ambient_mana_collector = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Anti_Magic_Barrier }
		DA_Complete.ME_Anti_Magic_Barrier = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Floating_Fortress }
		DA_Complete.ME_Floating_Fortress = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Core_Driller }
		DA_Complete.ME_Core_Driller = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Mega_Hold }
		DA_Complete.ME_Mega_Hold = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Megalopolis }
		DA_Complete.ME_Megalopolis = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Mega_Port }
		DA_Complete.ME_Mega_Port = yes
	}
}
DA_ME_clear_research_flags = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_ambient_mana_collector
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Anti_Magic_Barrier
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Floating_Fortress
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Core_Driller
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Mega_Hold
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Megalopolis
	clr_country_flag = DA_research_flag.ME_Mega_Port
}
DA_Complete.ME_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve = {
	set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.ME_Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	set_country_flag = DA_ME_just_researched.Hyper_Conductive_Mana_Reserve
	country_event = { id = DA_Mega_Engineering_events.1 }
}

######## Metal discovery for Mine VI-VIII (Core Driller) ########

# Same pattern as DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_2..5 in DA_Metallurgy_effects.txt. Called only from the
# DA_ME_core_driller_discovery province triggered modifier, where random_list rolls properly.
DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_6 = {
	random_list = {
		5 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_common = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Common = yes
		}
		55 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_rare = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Rare = yes
		}
		40 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_legendary = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Legendary = yes
		}
	}
}
DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_7 = {
	random_list = {
		45 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_rare = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Rare = yes
		}
		55 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_legendary = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Legendary = yes
		}
	}
}
DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_8 = {
	random_list = {
		30 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_rare = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Rare = yes
		}
		70 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { DA_prov_has_all_metals_legendary = yes } }
			DA_add_Metal_Legendary = yes
		}
	}
}

######## Interface ########

DA_ME_open_interface = {
	set_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Genetic_Engineering
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mana_Core
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mega_Engineering
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.genetic_engineering
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.mega_engineering }
		}
		DA_GE_open_tab = yes # build_genetic_engineering.py
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mega_Engineering
		DA_ME_recount = yes
	}
}
DA_ME_close_interface = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Genetic_Engineering
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mana_Core
	clr_country_flag = DA_Ascension_Paths_interface_on_Mega_Engineering
}
